name: BAMPSL Securities Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1995, BAMPSL Securities Ltd deals in securities and to provide financial & Investment assistance[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
BAMPSL is a Non-Systematically Important Non-Deposit Taking Non-Banking Financial Company engaged in dealing and investing in shares and other securities. It also provides financial services such as spot financing, short-term financial accommodation, long-term financial accommodation, and other related financial sector activities.

pros: Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 265 days to 66.9 days
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 1.90% over last 3 years.
Debtor days have increased from 27.4 to 43.6 days.
